_about: Every gate a command can require. Only scripts/approve.py (run through /approve) can set one. 'met' means Approved or Approved with Conditions, and every file recorded with the approval is unchanged.

b1_entity.label: Block 1.1 - Entity foundation approved (category entity, area entity, variant list, reserved homepage variant)

b1_proof_sheet_ready.label: Block 1.2 - Client proof sheet prepared from discovery and reviewed by Paul (ready for Paul to send)

b1_proof_sheet_returned.label: Block 1.3 - Client completed and returned the proof sheet

b1_brand_guide.label: Block 1.4 - Brand Guide / business-truth record complete; proof sheet reconciled (verified facts separated from unsupported claims)

b1_audit.label: Block 1.5 - Audit deliverables complete and approved (Finding Register, URL Decision Map, Recommendations, Evidence Manifest)

block1.label: Block 1 - Audit findings -> page work (Paul signs)

b2_blockers.label: Build - Technical blocker checklist cleared and tracking stable

block2.label: Block 2 - All pages live -> link wheel

block4.label: Block 4 - Blog Decision Map approved -> redirects and blog briefs

bab_topics.label: Blog Authority Builder - topic list approved (checked against service and location page FAQs)

impl_safe.label: Implementation gate 1 - audit approved: client-independent fixes (broken links, alt text, image URLs, sitemap, robots.txt, meta description duplicates, speed)

impl_structural.label: Implementation gate 2 - proof sheet reconciled + entity approved: redirects, URL/slug changes, consolidations, SEO titles and H1s
